{{Top|ga}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:UnidentifiedBigBrowedSpecies-Day.png]] |name=Wiltoo Kajok |homeworld=[[Khofar]]''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' |birth=c. [[181 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' establishes that Wiltoo Kajok is forty-nine [[Standard year|years]] old during the main events of ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which take place in [[132 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TheAcolyteDate|here]]. Therefore, he must have been [[Reproduction|born]] around [[181 BBY]]. ''The Acolyte: The Visual Guide'' also establishes [[Taibik Kajok]] was fifty-two years old during the events of ''The Acolyte'', meaning he was born around [[184 BBY]] |death= |species=[[Huwawan]] |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |height=1.73 [[meter]]s (5 [[Foot|ft]] 8 in) |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin=[[Color|Tan]] |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings=[[Taibik Kajok]] |children= |affiliation= |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|The locals say he ventured off into the forest and never came back.|Jecki Lon, reporting information on Kelnacca she had learned from Kajok|{{Acolyte|Day (episode)}}}} '''Wiltoo Kajok''' was a [[Huwawan]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Khofar]]. Wiltoo and his older brother, [[Taibik Kajok]], worked as guides for tourists on Khofar in their younger days. When they became older, the brothers stopped working as guides and instead stayed at a tent near a basic [[spaceport]] that they maintained, where they bartered or sold safety tips, [[map]] programs, and survival gear. In [[132 BBY]], when a [[Khofar Jedi task force|team]] of [[Jedi]] visited the spaceport on a [[Mission to Khofar|mission]] to extract [[Jedi Master]] [[Kelnacca]], Wiltoo spoke to [[Padawan]] [[Jecki Lon]] and informed her Kelnacca had ventured into the [[forest]] and never returned. The next morning, Wiltoo and Taibik played a game of [[dejarik]] together, and Wiltoo knocked several pieces off the board when their [[Gambling|betting]] grew heated. Later, Wiltoo again spoke with a team of Jedi, who had come to investigate the [[death]]s of most of the previous Jedi team. ==Biography== {{Quote|What did they say?''"
"''Seems an umbramoth colony hatched last night and wreaked havoc on a local settlement.|Vernestra Rwoh and Mog Adana|{{Acolyte|Teach / Corrupt}}}} Wiltoo Kajok was a [[Huwawan]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Khofar]] who was [[Reproduction|born]] around [[181 BBY]]. He was the younger brother of [[Taibik Kajok]], who was born around [[184 BBY]]. The two brothers maintained a [[spaceport]] that had only basic amenities for travelers. In their younger days, Wiltoo and Taibik worked as guides that led tourists along the few trails through Khofar's [[forest]]s. When they became older, they instead stayed at their dockside tent, where they wished explorers luck and bartered or sold safety tips, [[map]] programs, and survival gear. At one point, Wiltoo was exposed to a jungle illness that resulted in his [[hair]] thinning. [[File:KajokBrothersDejarik-TeachCorrupt.png|thumb|right|300px|The brothers play a game of dejarik.]] In [[132 BBY]],{{TheAcolyteDate}} a [[Khofar Jedi task force|team]] of [[Jedi]] arrived on Khofar to [[Mission to Khofar|extract]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Kelnacca]] from his post on the planet and landed at the brothers' spaceport. Using a [[translatacomp]], [[Padawan]] [[Jecki Lon]] spoke to Wiltoo in [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]], describing Kelnacca and informing Wiltoo the Jedi were looking for him. While seated on his [[throne]]-like [[leather]] chair,{{Acolyte|Day (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}} Wiltoo responded in an obscure variant of [[Huwawi]] that the translatacomp found hard to analyze, telling her that Kelnacca had ventured into the forest and never returned. Eventually, he rose indignantly and gave a dismissive wave to Lon as she rejoined the other Jedi, who she then informed of what she had learned. The Jedi then traveled into the forest, where most of them were killed by a [[Sith]] known as [[the Stranger]]. The next morning, Wiltoo and Taibik played a low-tech, high-stakes version of [[dejarik]] on a rustic board. Although they pooled their [[Currency|money]], their [[Gambling|wagering]] grew heated, and Wiltoo knocked several pieces off the board.{{Acolyte|Night}} The brothers ignored{{Acolyte|Night}} {{AD|Disney+}} the surviving members of the Jedi team walking past them. Later, Jedi Master [[Vernestra Rwoh]] arrived at the brothers' spaceport with another team to investigate the deaths of the first group. Wiltoo sat on his chair with Taibik standing next to him while speaking with the Jedi. The brothers informed the team that an [[Umbramoth]] colony had hatched the previous night. They continued to speak with another Jedi as Padawan{{Databank|mog-adana|Mog Adana}} [[Mog Adana]] informed Rwoh about the hatching of the umbramoth colony and suggested it could have been responsible for the deaths. The team then left to investigate the location where the Jedi had died. ==Personality and traits== Wiltoo had [[Color|tan]] skin, thinning brown hair, and dark [[eye]]s. He stood 1.73 [[meter]]s (5 [[Foot|feet]] 8 inches) tall. By 132 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], when he was forty-nine standard years old, he had creaking [[bone]]s and a sore back. He had had his fill of thrill-seekers who wandered off-trail and chose to stay at his dockside tent with Taibik. The brothers filled their time by playing dejarik, and although they pooled their money, their betting grew heated, with Wiltoo knocking pieces off the board during one game. Wiltoo was more ambitious than Taibik and imagined turning their stretch of land into more than a barren field. He envisioned lodging, restaurants, and a proper port, but had only a dim awareness of what property laws and increased traffic would entail. ==Skills and abilities== Wiltoo spoke an obscure variant of Huwawi that Jedi translatacomps struggled to analyze. ==Equipment== Wiltoo wore a brown [[Clothing|shirt]], a purple cloth around his neck, pants with a red and brown pattern, black [[water]]proof [[boot]]s, and knuckle guarded work [[glove]]s. He wore a brown [[belt]] with sedative [[gas grenade]]s for wildlife safety, colored smoke gas [[grenade]]s, and an emergency transmitter beacon. On one [[Limb|arm]] he wore tagging [[Homing beacon|tracker]] [[dart]] tubes. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:WiltooConcept-ArtOfAcolyte.png|thumb|right|200px|Concept art by Ivan Manzella]] Wiltoo Kajok first appeared, albeit unidentified, in "[[Day (episode)|Day]]," the fourth episode of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which premiered [[June 18]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=series/the-acolyte/season-1-episode-4-day-episode-guide|text="Day" Episode Guide | The Acolyte}} He was identified in [[Pablo Hidalgo]]'s [[2025]] reference book, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''. The scenes at the landing site{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}} including Wiltoo were filmed at the [[Wikipedia:Portugal|Portuguese]] island [[Wikipedia:Madeira Island|Madeira]]. Concept art of Wiltoo was created by [[Ivan Manzella]]. Wiltoo and Taibik were originally designed to be patrons of the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] during the opening sequence of the ''The Acolyte''{{'s}} first episode, "[[Lost / Found]],"''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' which aired on [[June 3]], 2024.{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} However, showrunner [[Leslye Headland]] liked the design of the brothers so much that they were moved to the landing site, which had more sun. The [[2026]]{{Abrams|url=product/art-of-star-wars-the-acolyte_9781419777349|text=The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte}} reference book ''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', written by [[Kristin Baver]], describes Wiltoo and Taibik as [[twin]]s; however, ''Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide'' had previously established the brothers to be different ages. ===Concept art gallery=== {{Gallery |source=''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' |storyboards= |concept= File:Unidentified-Big-Browed-Species-Manzella.jpg|Concept art by Ivan Manzella{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creatures & Character Designs|author=Manzella, Ivan|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20250715083228}} File:WiltooConcept-ArtOfAcolyte.png|Concept art by Ivan Manzella |digital= |in-progress= }} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Wiltoo Kajok}} *{{Acolyte|Day (episode)}} {{1st}} *{{Acolyte|Night}} *{{Acolyte|Teach / Corrupt}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|Wiltoo Kajok}} *''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უილტუ კაჯოკი }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Kajok, Wiltoo}} [[Category:Huwawans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
